message_1_subject: Preview: demo scheduled Oct 20 — possible reschedule needed
message_1_body:
Hi Tom / Alicia,

Quick note — we have the customer-facing demo on Oct 20, 10:00–11:00 PT on the calendar. During your intake call yesterday you mentioned additional reviewers from Security and Procurement would join. Those groups typically want a longer run-through (90–120 minutes) and a short technical dry-run for infra.

Can you confirm whether the security and procurement reviewers will be able to attend on Oct 20? If not, please tell us the earliest dates that work for the expanded panel. If the original slot is still best for product stakeholders, we can propose a two-part approach (technical dry-run + longer demo) but want to avoid back-and-forth at the last minute given travel schedules.

Suggested options from our side:
- Option A: Move to Oct 25, 14:00–16:00 PT (two-hour block) — we do a 90-min demo + 15-min procurement Qs + 15-min buffer.
- Option B: Keep Oct 20 10:00–11:00 PT for product execs, and schedule a separate 60–90 min session for security/procurement the following week.

Cc'ing Olga (solutions), Dev (infra), Marissa (AE) and Karthik (legal touchpoint) to ensure we have the right folks ready if we shift. I've attached an updated agenda and procurement checklist for reference.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
